gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent high-grade glioma (HGG), including diffuse midline glioma (DMG) and non-DMG, based on RAPNO criteria confirmed by central radiological review, with or without histology if biopsy performed prior to inclusion;

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will receive the IMP which is the AsiDNA (etidaligide). AsiDNA will be administered intravenously as a 1-hour infusion.
AsiDNA™ is a DNA repair inhibitor that increases the vulnerability of tumour cells to irradiation without increasing toxicity in healthy tissues.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters of AsiDNA.: Maximal observed drug concentration (Cmax);

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Radiotherapy + AsiDNA: Patients will receive the IMP which is the AsiDNA (etidaligide).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational DNA repair inhibitor (DNA-damage signalling decoy oligonucleotide, AsiDNA/etidaligide)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: AsiDNA™ is a DNA repair inhibitor that increases the vulnerability of tumour cells to irradiation without increasing toxicity in healthy tissues.

coder_notes: Population is paediatric/AYA (12 months to <25 years) recurrent high-grade glioma including DMG/DIPG; glioblastoma is not named anywhere, so S5 = high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclusion). The ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm 'Radiotherapy' lists 'Drug: AsiDNA' as its intervention in the registry, but its description is radiotherapy only; AsiDNA was therefore linked only to the experimental arm. PK sample type not stated, so tumour_pk_planned = unclear (W7). Histone mutations mentioned in the summary only as disease description, not coded as biomarkers.
